create_SentenceEmbedder_reload: create a SentenceEmbedder from a pretrained model checkpoint path and params
create_SentenceEmbedder_get_embeddings: create sentence embeddings from input tensors with lengths and optional positions and langs
create_SentenceEmbedder_get_parameters: create a parameter list for optimizer from a transformer layer range string
test_SentenceEmbedder_train: test the SentenceEmbedder train method to set model to training mode
test_SentenceEmbedder_eval: test the SentenceEmbedder eval method to set model to evaluation mode
